pill_title: Extension version {version}. Click to check for updates.
checking_body: Looking for the newest release on GitHub.
no_asset: This release has no file to download here. Get it from the release page.
steps_intro: Shop Helper was loaded unpacked, so Chrome can’t install it for you. To finish:
step_extract: Open the downloaded zip file and extract it.
step_replace: Copy everything inside its shop-helper folder into the folder Shop Helper was loaded from, replacing the old files. Keep the same folder so your settings stay.
step_reload: On the extensions page, press Reload on RNGidle Shop Helper.
interrupted_body: Chrome stopped the download. Try again, or get the file from the release page.
error_offline: Couldn’t reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
error_rate_limited: GitHub is limiting how often it can be asked. Try again in an hour.
error_bad_reply: GitHub sent an answer that couldn’t be read. Try again later.
error_no_release: No release of Shop Helper was found on GitHub.
error_no_release_hint: Pre-releases are turned off in Settings, so only full releases count.
error_no_answer: The extension didn’t answer. Reload it on the extensions page and try again.
action_no_update: There’s no update to download right now. Check again first.
action_bad_url: The download link didn’t point to the Shop Helper releases on GitHub, so it wasn’t opened. Use the release page instead.
action_download_failed: Chrome couldn’t start the download. Try again, or use the release page.
action_no_download: The downloaded file isn’t there any more. Download it again.
settings_intro: Shop Helper was loaded unpacked, so Chrome won’t update it by itself. It can look for new releases for you.
auto_label: Check for updates when I open RNGidle
auto_hint: At most once every 6 hours. You can always click the version number at the top.
prereleases_hint: Beta and alpha versions, which can have rough edges.
privacy: Checking contacts GitHub (api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com) and nothing else. No personal data is sent.
